note: [L] (`stepTotal`) moves only in the positive direction and needs every point of K to be 4r-separated; [M] also moves negatively with the separation assumed only at x, which [L] covers only when the endpoint is also separated.

snippet.text:
lemma stepTotal {m : ℕ} (H : C.Makes) (v : Fin (m+1)→C.book.Token) {A r : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ A)
    (hr : 0<r) (K : Set (Points (m+1))) (p N D : ℕ) (hd : D≤N) (h : Permit v A D N p)
    (he : ∀ x∈K, allFine C.S p (4*r) x) (hv : C.S.a D < r)
    (k : Fin (m+1)) (i : Axis) (l : ℕ) (u : positions (m+1))
    (hq : tag (C.S.a N) u ∈ K) (hb : dist (tag (C.S.a N) (advance u k i l)) (tag (C.S.a N) u) ≤ r) :
    dist (lifted C N p v (advance u k i l)) (lifted C N p v u) ≤
      (A^(m+1)/r)*dist (tag (C.S.a N) (advance u k i l)) (tag (C.S.a N) u) := by

proof_context.conclusion: From an all-fine (separation 4r) start with `a D < r` and a `Permit` root bound A, a positive one-coordinate move by `l` grid steps of metric size at most r changes `lifted C N p v` by at most `A^(m+1)/r` times the displacement.
